Id.description: Unique identifier of the cancellation policy.

RateGroupId.description: Unique identifier of the rate group the cancellation policy belongs to.

CreatedUtc.description: Date and time of the cancellation policy creation in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Date and time of the cancellation policy update in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

FeeExtent.description: Extent for the cancellation fee, i.e. what should be in scope for the automatic payment.

ApplicabilityOffset.description: Offset for order start (assuming Applicability is set to Start) from which the fee is applied.

FeeMaximumTimeUnits.description: Maximum number of time units the cancellation fee is applicable to.

RelativeFee.description: Relative value of the fee, as a percentage of the reservation price.

IsActive.description: Whether the cancellation policy is still active.
